items.title: 手机用途
items.content: The table shows the percentages of mobile phone owners using various mobile phone features.

items.title: 手机用途
items.content: The table compares the percentages of people using different functions of their mobile phones between 2006 and 2010.

items.title: 手机用途
items.content: Throughout the period shown, the main reason why people used their mobile phones was to make calls. However, there was a marked increase in the popularity of other mobile phone features, particularly the Internet search feature.

items.title: 手机用途
items.content: In 2006, 100% of mobile phone owners used their phones to make calls, while the next most popular functions were text messaging (73%) and taking photos (66%). By contrast, less than 20% of owners played games or music on their phones, and there were no figures for users doing Internet searches or recording video.

items.title: 手机用途
items.content: Over the following 4 years, there was relatively little change in the figures for the top three mobile phone features. However, the percentage of people using their phones to access the Internet jumped to 41% in 2008 and then to 73% in 2010. There was also a significant rise in the use of mobiles to play games and to record video, with figures reaching 41% and 35% respectively in 2010.
